name: Operations ledger
business_process_overview: Intake covers Fault Reported, Request Opened, Request Triaged, Risk Assessed, Request Approved.
Work planning covers Work Order Opened, Technician Assigned, Inspection Performed, Scope Agreed, Work Released.
Parts covers Reservation Opened, Part Allocated, Stock Checked, Part Issued, Reservation Settled.
Field work covers Work Item Started, Adjustment Made, Component Replaced, Function Tested, Work Item Finished.
Acceptance covers Verification Started, Reading Taken, Equipment Accepted, Work Order Closed, Request Closed.
